name: Reader
text: Ramp’s server-side skip link forces every user to download and parse an extra element on every page load—wasting bandwidth and slowing rendering for sighted users who don’t need it. A better fix is a client-side skip link that only renders when keyboard focus reaches the first interactive element, cutting the waste while keeping the benefit. Settle it with a quick A/B test: measure page load time and keyboard user success rates with both versions.

name: Reader
text: Client-side skip links fail when JavaScript is disabled or slow to load—locking out keyboard users who need them most. A hybrid approach: server-side skip link with `display: none` and client-side JS to toggle visibility on focus. Settle it with a live test: measure load-time impact of the hidden server-side link versus the failure rate of the client-only version.
